Restate only the main (public) question.
Compute \(47 \times 26 - 20 \times 21\).

First, calculate \(47 \times 26\):
\[47 \times 26 = 47 \times (20 + 6) = 47 \times 20 + 47 \times 6\]
\[47 \times 20 = 940\]
\[47 \times 6 = 282\]
So,
\[47 \times 26 = 940 + 282 = 1222\]

Next, calculate \(20 \times 21\):
\[20 \times 21 = 420\]

Now, subtract the results:
\[1222 - 420 = 802\]

To double-check, let's verify the main result using an alternative method:
\[47 \times 26 - 20 \times 21 = (47 \times 26) - (20 \times 21)\]
We can also break down \(47 \times 26\) into simpler parts and then adjust:
\[47 \times 26 = (50 - 3) \times 26 = 50 \times 26 - 3 \times 26\]
\[50 \times 26 = 1300\]
\[3 \times 26 = 78\]
So,
\[47 \times 26 = 1300 - 78 = 1222\]
And we already know:
\[20 \times 21 = 420\]
Thus,
\[1222 - 420 = 802\]
